title: simpliCRM — Field Sales Management
description: A cross-platform Flutter CRM application engineered for real-time field sales operations, GPS route tracking, dealer conversions, and seamless enquiry-to-order workflows.
about: simpliCRM empowers enterprise sales teams by streamlining field operations with offline-aware data collection, site verification, dealer management, and intelligent route planning. Built with robust GetX state management and clean REST API integration.
features: Real-time GPS tracking and dynamic route planning for field officers
End-to-end enquiry-to-order processing with status tracking
Role-based dynamic interfaces and offline-aware field synchronization
Responsive UI optimized for Android, iOS, and Web viewports

title: simpliDELIVER — Dispatch & Logistics Management
description: Enterprise Flutter dispatch and logistics management system for handling loading slips, automated weighing, invoices, and material dispatches.
about: simpliDELIVER handles complex logistics workflows across dispatch centers. Incorporates PlutoGrid for high-performance dynamic data tables, Dio HTTP client for robust REST API handling, and strict business validations for enterprise operations.
features: Automated loading slip generation, weighing integration & instant invoicing
High-performance dynamic data tables using PlutoGrid with sorting and inline editing
Role-based multi-tier approval and dispatch operations workflow
Product, raw material, and inventory dispatch validations
Dio HTTP client integration with error interceptors and retry policies

title: simpliEXPENSE — Expense & Advance Management
description: Enterprise expense and cash advance management app featuring multi-level hierarchical approval workflows and high-performance financial data grids.
about: simpliEXPENSE simplifies employee reimbursement, expense heads allocation, and advance limit management. Built with Syncfusion DataGrid for complex pagination & filtering, alongside multi-level approval hierarchies spanning Employee, HOD, HR, Director, and Finance roles.
features: Employee expense filing with digital bill receipt uploads & category tagging
Cash advance request system with dynamic threshold limits & reference tracking
Hierarchical approval workflow (Employee -> HOD -> HR -> Director -> Finance)
Syncfusion DataGrid integration for fast pagination, search, and CSV export
Modular, reusable enterprise UI component architecture across Web & Mobile
